messages:
maria: Heads-up — ran a full perf pass on the 8xA100 TP+PP config to repro the latency regressions after the flash-attn change. results attached in-thread.
sam: Nice, what's the top offender? QKV comms again? :grimacing:
maria: yeah, QKV all-gather scatter pattern increased from ~9% to ~27% of step time on long-prefix workloads. nvprof snapshot:
maria: ```
GPU activities:
  AllGather    Time(%)  27.1  Calls 16  Avg 3.2ms
  Kernel: flash_fused_attn  Time(%) 49.4  Calls 800  Avg 0.8ms
  Kernel: qkv_transpose_shard  Time(%) 6.8
```
jonah: 27% allgather is bad — that lines up with the observed tail latency spikes. Is the QKV layout becoming non-contiguous because of our TP sharding change?
maria: yes, when seq_len > 1024 and chunk_size heuristic switched we land on a scatter layout so NCCL can't do steady contiguous transfers, causing stride penalties on PCIe/NVLink.
anya: I also saw KV cache inflation — prefix cache entries are being synced per-tensor instead of per-shard after the kernel selector fallback. that doubles comms.
sam: So two things: (1) kernel selector picks fallback fused-attn variant that expects per-GPU contiguous QKV, (2) batching heuristic picks chunk_size that increases cross-device fragmentation. both combine multiplicatively.
jonah: Quick mitigation ideas:
- force contiguous QKV layout for TP when seq_len < 2048 and use local fusion path
- change batcher to prefer smaller chunk_count up to a latency SLO
- overlap NCCL allgather with flash kernels via CUDA streams (async-compute overlap)
maria: I tried a patch forcing QKV pack to contiguous when seq_len < 2048 and re-ran. AllGather dropped to 11% and p99 latency down ~18%.
maria: short diff snippet:
maria: ```c++
if (seq_len < 2048 && tp_shards > 1) {
  qkv_layout = contiguous_pack(); // avoids scatter allgather
}
```
sam: Nice. Any regression tradeoffs on throughput?
maria: small throughput hit on synthetic max-batch (2-3%) but much better p99. for production workloads p99 matters more.
anya: We should also add a selector rule: prefer fused-attn-local when prefix_cache_enabled && kv_cache_synced_per_shard == false
jonah: Also recorded perf counters showing NCCL wait for kernel events. We can try enabling ncclAsyncAllReduce and cudaStreamPerThread overlap in the runtime to reduce the gap.
deploy-bot: deploy requested by maria:branch/tp-qkv-contiguous -> staging
sam: After staging test run, keep an eye for memory pressure — contiguous pack increases temporary memory.
maria: will run 24h soak and flag if any OOMs. planning to submit a formal perf regression ticket with traces and nvprof captures.
anya: add a /eval prompt set that stresses long-prefix + small-batch to avoid future surprises.
jonah: TL;DR: root cause = kernel selection fallback + batching chunking -> strided QKV all-gather; short-term: force contiguous pack and enable NCCL async overlap; long-term: add selector rules and improve batching cost model. :thumbsup:
